title: Birds: name the family
intro: Name the taxonomic family of each animal (birds).

questions.prompt: To which family does the Eurasian Treecreeper (Certhia familiaris) belong?
questions.explain: The Eurasian Treecreeper (Certhia familiaris) belongs to the family treecreeper, order passerines.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Ibisbill (Ibidorhyncha struthersii) belong?
questions.explain: The Ibisbill (Ibidorhyncha struthersii) belongs to the family Ibidorhynchidae, order Charadriiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Beach Stone-curlew (Esacus magnirostris) belong?
questions.explain: The Beach Stone-curlew (Esacus magnirostris) belongs to the family Burhinidae, order Charadriiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Red-backed Mousebird (Colius castanotus) belong?
questions.explain: The Red-backed Mousebird (Colius castanotus) belongs to the family mousebird, order Coliiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Sapayoa (Sapayoa aenigma) belong?
questions.explain: The Sapayoa (Sapayoa aenigma) belongs to the family Sapayoidae, order passerines.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Dwarf Cassowary (Casuarius bennetti) belong?
questions.explain: The Dwarf Cassowary (Casuarius bennetti) belongs to the family Casuariidae, order Casuariiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the rosy thrush-tanager (Rhodinocichla rosea) belong?
questions.explain: The rosy thrush-tanager (Rhodinocichla rosea) belongs to the family Rhodinocichlidae, order passerines.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Spotted Elachura (Elachura formosa) belong?
questions.explain: The Spotted Elachura (Elachura formosa) belongs to the family Elachuridae, order passerines.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Limpkin (Aramus guarauna) belong?
questions.explain: The Limpkin (Aramus guarauna) belongs to the family Aramidae, order Gruiformes.

questions.prompt: To which family does the Pin-tailed Whydah (Vidua macroura) belong?
questions.explain: The Pin-tailed Whydah (Vidua macroura) belongs to the family Viduidae, order passerines.
